Mrs. Sireesha Rani Vallabhaneni,
 Standing Counsel for Municipalities  GP for Animal Husbandary
CORAM :THE CHIEF JUSTICE DHIRAJ SINGH THAKUR  SRI JUSTICE RAVI CHEEMALAPATI  DATE : 23th April 2025

PC: 
 The issue that has been raised in the present petition is with regard to  the illegal operation of the slaughter house within Ward-I, Agraharam  (Malapeta) of Pithapuram Municipality.
 2.
Mr. K. S. Murthy, learned Senior Counsel appearing for the  petitioner,

has drawn our attention to communication, dated 17.08.2024,
 issued by the Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board, wherein it has been  stated that the Municipal Authorities had not obtained the permission of the  Pollution Control Board Authorities for operation of the slaughter house, which  was being run contrary to the provisions of the Prevention of Cruelty to  Animals (Slaughter House) Rules, 2001, and the Environment Protection Act,
\ 1986, and was also unlicensed.

entities.text: Prevention of Cruelty to  Animals (Slaughter House) Rules, 2001
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2  HCJ   W.P.{PIL)

3. Our attention has also been drawn to communication, 
 18,02.2025, issued by the Collector, Kakinada District, wherein it had directed  the Commissioner, Pithapuram Municipality, to take necessary action for  closure of the illegal slaughter house.
4. The Commissioner of the Pithapuram Municipality has appeared  through the Virtual Mode before us and undertakes to immediately close it  down.
An affidavit be filed in this regard within two (2) days from today with  Registry of this Court regarding the closure of the slaughter house.

Liberty,
 however, is granted to the Municipal Authorities, Pithapuram, to apply for  proper permissions from the concerned authorities including the   Control Board Authorities for running the slaughter house after completion of Animal Rescue Organisation vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 23 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/128854303/
4  the requisite formalities in accordance with the relevant Rules and Regulations  in force in regard thereto.
